topics.purpose: Define exact acquisition/release lifecycle, contention behavior and ownership checks for runtime locks.

semantics.acquire_rule: Acquire targets exact lock/resource identity and requested mode.
semantics.holder_rule: Successful acquire records exact holder execution/context.
semantics.release_rule: Release must reference/authorize the current holder or explicit administrative override.
semantics.timeout_rule: Acquire timeout is explicit failure evidence.
semantics.cleanup_rule: Execution termination interacts with lock release according to explicit policy.
semantics.authority_rule: Acquire success does not replace operation authorization.

invariants.rule: Definitions, requests, validation evidence, authorization decisions and concrete executions remain separate identities; only an explicit validated and authorized dispatcher path may create effects.

hard_gates.condition: lock acquired by filename race only
